comment: Thrown when a non locally recoverable playback failure occurs.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_UNSPECIFIED
variables.comment: Caused by an error whose cause could not be identified.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_REMOTE_ERROR
variables.comment:
* Caused by an unidentified error in a remote Player, which is a Player that runs on a different
   * host or process.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_BEHIND_LIVE_WINDOW
variables.comment: Caused by the loading position falling behind the sliding window of available live content.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: Caused by a generic timeout.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_FAILED_RUNTIME_CHECK
variables.comment:
* Caused by a failed runtime check. * *

This can happen when the application fails to comply with the player's API requirements (for * example, by passing invalid arguments), or when the player reaches an invalid state.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_IO_UNSPECIFIED
variables.comment: Caused by an Input/Output error which could not be identified.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_IO_NETWORK_CONNECTION_FAILED
variables.comment:
* Caused by a network connection failure. * *

The following is a non-exhaustive list of possible reasons: * *

    *
  • There is no network connectivity (you can check this by querying {@link * ConnectivityManager#getActiveNetwork}). *
  • The URL's domain is misspelled or does not exist. *
  • The target host is unreachable. *
  • The server unexpectedly closes the connection. *

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_IO_NETWORK_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: Caused by a network timeout, meaning the server is taking too long to fulfill a request.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_IO_INVALID_HTTP_CONTENT_TYPE
variables.comment:
* Caused by a server returning a resource with an invalid "Content-Type" HTTP header value. * *

For example, this can happen when the player is expecting a piece of media, but the server * returns a paywall HTML page, with content type "text/html".

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_IO_BAD_HTTP_STATUS
variables.comment: Caused by an HTTP server returning an unexpected HTTP response status code.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_IO_FILE_NOT_FOUND
variables.comment: Caused by a non-existent file.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_IO_NO_PERMISSION
variables.comment:
* Caused by lack of permission to perform an IO operation. For example, lack of permission to
   * access internet or external storage.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_IO_CLEARTEXT_NOT_PERMITTED
variables.comment:
* Caused by the player trying to access cleartext HTTP traffic (meaning http:// rather than * https://) when the app's Network Security Configuration does not permit it. * *

See this corresponding * troubleshooting topic.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_IO_READ_POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE
variables.comment: Caused by reading data out of the data bound.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_PARSING_CONTAINER_MALFORMED
variables.comment: Caused by a parsing error associated with a media container format bitstream.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_PARSING_MANIFEST_MALFORMED
variables.comment:
* Caused by a parsing error associated with a media manifest. Examples of a media manifest are a
   * DASH or a SmoothStreaming manifest, or an HLS playlist.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_PARSING_CONTAINER_UNSUPPORTED
variables.comment:
* Caused by attempting to extract a file with an unsupported media container format, or an
   * unsupported media container feature.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_PARSING_MANIFEST_UNSUPPORTED
variables.comment:
* Caused by an unsupported feature in a media manifest. Examples of a media manifest are a DASH
   * or a SmoothStreaming manifest, or an HLS playlist.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DECODER_INIT_FAILED
variables.comment: Caused by a decoder initialization failure.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DECODER_QUERY_FAILED
variables.comment: Caused by a decoder query failure.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DECODING_FAILED
variables.comment: Caused by a failure while trying to decode media samples.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DECODING_FORMAT_EXCEEDS_CAPABILITIES
variables.comment: Caused by trying to decode content whose format exceeds the capabilities of the device.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DECODING_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED
variables.comment: Caused by trying to decode content whose format is not supported.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_AUDIO_TRACK_INIT_FAILED
variables.comment: Caused by an AudioTrack initialization failure.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_AUDIO_TRACK_WRITE_FAILED
variables.comment: Caused by an AudioTrack write operation failure.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DRM_UNSPECIFIED
variables.comment: Caused by an unspecified error related to DRM protection.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DRM_SCHEME_UNSUPPORTED
variables.comment:
* Caused by a chosen DRM protection scheme not being supported by the device. Examples of DRM
   * protection schemes are ClearKey and Widevine.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DRM_PROVISIONING_FAILED
variables.comment: Caused by a failure while provisioning the device.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DRM_CONTENT_ERROR
variables.comment:
* Caused by attempting to play incompatible DRM-protected content. * *

For example, this can happen when attempting to play a DRM protected stream using a scheme * (like Widevine) for which there is no corresponding license acquisition data (like a pssh box).

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DRM_LICENSE_ACQUISITION_FAILED
variables.comment: Caused by a failure while trying to obtain a license.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DRM_DISALLOWED_OPERATION
variables.comment: Caused by an operation being disallowed by a license policy.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DRM_SYSTEM_ERROR
variables.comment: Caused by an error in the DRM system.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DRM_DEVICE_REVOKED
variables.comment: Caused by the device having revoked DRM privileges.

variables.name: ERROR_CODE_DRM_LICENSE_EXPIRED
variables.comment: Caused by an expired DRM license being loaded into an open DRM session.

variables.name: CUSTOM_ERROR_CODE_BASE
variables.comment:
* Player implementations that want to surface custom errors can use error codes greater than this
   * value, so as to avoid collision with other error codes defined in this class.

variables.name: errorCode
variables.comment: An error code which identifies the cause of the playback failure.

variables.name: timestampMs
variables.comment: The value of {@link SystemClock#elapsedRealtime()} when this exception was created.

variables.name: FIELD_CUSTOM_ID_BASE
variables.comment:
* Defines a minimum field id value for subclasses to use when implementing {@link #toBundle()} * and {@link Bundleable.Creator}. * *

Subclasses should obtain their {@link Bundle Bundle's} field keys by applying a non-negative * offset on this constant and passing the result to {@link #keyForField(int)}.

variables.name: CREATOR
variables.comment: Object that can create a {@link PlaybackException} from a {@link Bundle}.

methods.name: public static String getErrorCodeName(@ErrorCode int errorCode)
methods.comment: Returns the name of a given {@code errorCode}.

methods.name: public boolean errorInfoEquals(@Nullable PlaybackException other)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the error data associated to this exception equals the error data associated to * {@code other}. * *

Note that this method does not compare the exceptions' stacktraces.

methods.name: protected static String keyForField(@FieldNumber int field)
methods.comment:
* Converts the given {@link FieldNumber} to a string which can be used as a field key when
   * implementing {@link #toBundle()} and {@link Bundleable.Creator}.

methods.comment: Creates a new {@link Throwable} with possibly {@code null} message.

methods.name: private static RemoteException createRemoteException(@Nullable String message)
methods.comment: Creates a new {@link RemoteException} with possibly {@code null} message.
